PC: Performs focused history and physical examination. Includes inquiring about bleeding risk factors and ensuring that there is no active bleeding from the surgical site.
Recommends anticoagulation and provides instructions for dosing/ formulation.
Provides recommendations for ongoing anticoagulant use
MK: Assesses for indications and contraindications to systemic thrombolysis.
Recognize that an IVC filter is not indicated
SBP: Contact the orthopedic surgery team to review the case and discuss the risks and benefits of anticoagulation.
Calls for help at the bedside and attempts to contact the attending physician.
Recommends patient is transferred to the ICU
Elicits help in managing the case from multidisciplinary team (e.g. nurse, orthopedic surgery team, ICU team)
ICS: Maintains good eye contact with embedded participants
Clarifies team goals and defines roles
PROF: Respectful and responsive to feedback from embedded participants
